method: merge origin/main into research-team without rewriting history; preserve both sides of append-only records and reconcile README navigation
append_only_ledgers: Retained records from both parents in chronological append order; parsed every nonempty line as JSON after resolution.
source_main_uncommitted_changes: Excluded. This synchronization contains only committed origin/main history; local ongoing research edits remain separate.
limitations: This synchronizes the shared base. Existing PR head branches may still need their own base updates; synchronization is not scientific evidence or an experiment merge.
